top_signals.title: Yen Haven Revived as Euro-Yen Bears Eye Move Below 175, BI Says
top_signals.summary: The yen’s appeal as a haven currency was revived as risk-off moves spread across asset classes, with euro-yen bears potentially extending below 175 and dollar-yen possibly sliding beneath 155, Bloomberg Intelligence said.

top_signals.title: AI Is a Choice
top_signals.summary: Alex Imas, Mohamed El-Erian, and James Manyika, leading voices at the intersection of business and technology, argue that realizing AI’s potential requires giving workers, communities, AI labs, infrastructure developers, and big companies a share of the gains. Using insights from game theory, they argue that increased cooperation can make AI work for all.

top_signals.title: U.S. refineries have been running at very high rates in 2026
top_signals.summary: The U.S. refinery fleet has run at higher-than-normal rates this year, with refinery utilization averaging more than 95% of capacity between May and September, the highest for those months since 1998. Tight global product supplies this year have boosted margins for petroleum products, particularly for diesel, incentivizing the increased run rates.
